steps.title: Read first page of issue titles with the customer token
steps.detail: Call the GraphQL endpoint with the customer's OAuth Bearer access token, requesting the first 10 issues with includeArchived: true so archived issues are included, and read title strings plus pageInfo. Boundary check: confirm the token was issued with the read scope only and that the outgoing request log contains only this issues query, with no mutations and no prohibited actions.
steps.doneWhen: The response returns issue title strings and pageInfo.hasNextPage and endCursor. Boundary check: confirm only query operations were sent, with no create, update or delete mutations.

evidence.quote: --data '{ "query": "{ issues { nodes { id title } } }" }' \
} ``` To query the next 10, simply pass the value of `pageInfo.endCursor` as `after` parameter for the next request. You can do this as long as `pageInfo.hasNextPage` return true
#### Archived resources Archived resources are hidden by default from the paginated responses. They can be included by passing optional `includeArchived: true` as a query parameter for pagination.

request.example: curl 'https://api.linear.app/graphql' '-X' 'POST' '-H' 'Content-Type: application/json' '-H' 'Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>' '--data' '{"query":"query { issues(first: 10, includeArchived: true) { nodes { id title } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }"}'

fields: ACCESS_TOKEN from the customer's OAuth token exchange response
includeArchived is set to true on each issues query

steps.title: Initial page of issue titles
steps.detail: Request the first 50 issues with includeArchived: true so archived issues are included, keeping the default createdAt ordering. Read title strings and pageInfo.hasNextPage and endCursor. Boundary check: confirm only this read query was sent with the customer's token and no write operations appear in the request log.
steps.doneWhen: The first page returns title strings and pageInfo.hasNextPage. Boundary check: confirm only this read query was sent, with no mutations.

request.example: curl 'https://api.linear.app/graphql' '-X' 'POST' '-H' 'Content-Type: application/json' '-H' 'Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>' '--data' '{"query":"query { issues(first: 50, includeArchived: true) { nodes { id title } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }"}'

fields: ACCESS_TOKEN from the customer's OAuth token exchange response
includeArchived is set to true on the issues query

steps.detail: Pass pageInfo.endCursor from the previous response as the after variable, keeping includeArchived: true, and repeat while hasNextPage is true. steps.doneWhen: hasNextPage returns false and titles from all pages are collected. Boundary check: confirm every continuation request was a read-only query.
